Sandbox_RedDays_hygiene_items_spawn_on_c: The idea is that female corpses would often carry 1 or 2 spares and rarely a full package
Sandbox_RedDays_hygiene_item_packages_sp: Disable to only spawn spares and no packages. Needs item spawn on corpses enabled.
Sandbox_RedDays_affectsAllGenders_toolti: Enable to apply menstrual cycle to all characters regardless of gender
Sandbox_RedDays_phase_start_delay_enable: This is mainly for newly spawned players so players don't always start on the menstrual phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_PMS_ConsistentVsRandom_t: Enable for consistent PMS symptoms every cycle. The symptoms are randomly assigned at character creation. Disable for random PMS symptoms every cycle.
Sandbox_RedDays_painkillerEffectDuration: Each point is 10 mins. Default is 36x10=360 mins or 6 hours
Sandbox_RedDays_PMS_duration_upperbound_: Max time for PMS. PMS will ramp up towards the end of the luteal cycle and into the first day of the period.
Sandbox_RedDays_PMS_duration_lowerbound_: Min time for PMS. PMS will ramp up towards the end of the luteal cycle and into the first day of the period.
Sandbox_RedDays_menstrual_cycle_duration: The shortest possible length (in days) for a menstrual cycle.
The longest possible length (in days) for a menstrual cycle.
Sandbox_RedDays_red_phase_duration_lower: The shortest possible duration (in days) for the red (menstruation) phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_red_phase_duration_upper: The longest possible duration (in days) for the red (menstruation) phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_follicular_phase_duratio: The shortest possible duration (in days) for the follicular phase.
The longest possible duration (in days) for the follicular phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_ovulation_phase_duration: The shortest possible duration (in days) for the ovulation phase.
The longest possible duration (in days) for the ovulation phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_luteal_phase_duration_lo: The shortest possible duration (in days) for the luteal phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_luteal_phase_duration_up: The longest possible duration (in days) for the luteal phase.
Sandbox_RedDays_phase_start_delay_lowerB: The shortest amount of days before your first period occurs.
Sandbox_RedDays_phase_start_delay_upperB: The maximum amount of days before your first period occurs.
Sandbox_RedDays_healthEffectLowerBound_t: Scales the pain, discomfort, fatigue and endurance effects during your period.
Sandbox_RedDays_healthEffectUpperBound_t: Scales the pain, discomfort, fatigue and endurance effects during your period.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable Red Days TSS progression and treatment mechanics.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_lethal_enabled_toolt: If enabled, untreated Stage 3 can transition into Stage 4 toxic shock.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_risk_multiplier_pct_: Scales Stage 3 to Stage 4 risk gain. Lower is safer, higher is riskier.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_tampon_grace_hours_t: How long a tampon can be worn before it starts contributing to TSS exposure.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_warning_interval_min: How often TSS warning messages are shown while symptoms are active.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage0_duration_lowe: Minimum in-game hours before tampon exposure may begin progressing into Stage 1 infection. Lower values cause earlier infection onset.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage0_duration_uppe: Maximum in-game hours before Stage 0 (no infection) will progress into Stage 1 infection. Higher values delay initial infection onset.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage1_duration_lowe: Minimum in-game hours before Stage 1 (early infection) may progress into Stage 2 (established infection). Lower values accelerate infection progression.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage1_duration_uppe: Maximum in-game hours before Stage 1 infection will progress into Stage 2. Higher values allow early infection to persist longer.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage2_duration_lowe: Minimum in-game hours before Stage 2 (established infection) may progress into Stage 3 (severe systemic illness). Lower values increase progression speed.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_stage2_duration_uppe: Maximum in-game hours before Stage 2 infection will progress into Stage 3. Higher values delay severe illness onset.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_min_stage3_hours_too: Minimum in-game hours required in Stage 3 (severe infection) before Toxic Shock Syndrome (Stage 4) becomes eligible to occur. TSS cannot occur before this threshold is reached.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_complication_chance_: Hourly chance for sudden complications while pre-TSS infection is active. Complications are influenced by stress, fatigue, dehydration, and body temperature.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_abx_dose_cooldown_ho: Minimum hours between effective antibiotic doses during TSS treatment. Taking antibiotics sooner has no effect on the infection.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_abx_toxin_per_dose_t: How much each antibiotic dose reduces the TSS toxin score (out of 100). Higher values shorten the treatment course needed to recover from Stage 4 toxic shock.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_abx_suppress_window_: Hours after taking an antibiotic dose that fatal HP drain from Stage 4 TSS is suppressed. Gives a survival window between doses.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_fever_max_celsius_to: Absolute peak body temperature that TSS will drive the patient toward. At 40C symptoms intensify. At the default 42C, HP drain is at maximum. Staying cool slows the effective fever and reduces HP loss.
Sandbox_RedDays_tss_fever_ramp_hours_too: How many in-game hours for TSS fever to climb from a normal 37C to 40C in average conditions. Lower values cause faster, more aggressive fever onset.
